text_blocks.snippet: The ICD-10-CM code for a history of coronary artery disease (CAD) is Z86.79. This code falls under "Personal history of other diseases of the circulatory system" and indicates that the patient has a history of CAD but is not currently experiencing active symptoms. Additionally, if the patient has undergone a coronary angioplasty, the code Z95.5 can be used to indicate the presence of a coronary angioplasty implant and graft.
